name: browserforge-plugin-rendercv
description: Tailor a RenderCV resume to each job without inventing anything, render it to PDF, and keep a log of where you applied.

browserforge.description: Tailor RenderCV resumes per job (reorder and reword only, no invented facts), render PDFs into the upload folder, and track applications (no duplicates, daily limit).
browserforge.instructions: cv_* tools: cv_get to read the master CV, cv_tailor to make a per-job copy (it rejects any number, date, link or term that is not already in the master CV), cv_render for the PDF to upload, cv_applications check/add around every application.

cvDir.description: Folder with your master RenderCV YAML files (searched two levels deep)

maxPages.description: Reject a rendered CV longer than this many pages

dailyLimit.description: Most submitted applications per day cv_applications will allow
